title: Fairer Names
description: This pack renames 48 items, blocks, or biomes to more fair or better sounding names.
body:
# Fairer Names 

This resource pack renames **48** Minecraft biomes, blocks, and items. The names either make more sense, sound cooler, or a combination.

## PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT:
This uses a license that is equivalent to being within the Public Domain, so use it how you'd like.

## Pack Info:

(Also don't forget to click the heart button to follow, to support for more updates. And, if you would like, add it to collections or modpacks that you make!)

### Several Minecraft versions
It should work for Minecraft versions 1.14 to 1.21.100 (and likely further, maybe even previously). Be aware that in most versions, a warning may appear that it is for the wrong version, but it should work in most, so no worries.

#Update Info:
If there is mod that you would like this to be updated for, then email me at nightmarelore.10@gmail.com
I will then let you know if I am legally able to update it for compatibility. If I can, I will update it.
